items.note: Light is consistent over the protein; crevices darken with occlusion. Presentation edge roughness remains a Phase 7 comparison item, not a claim of superior appearance.
Both converged and single-frame captures are finite, populated and free of visible holes or conflicting faces in the reviewed stills. Orbit/video stability is not certified by a still.
Same camera for all engines; coloured silhouette widths agree within 1%, measured in target/cartoon-shape-verification/framing.json.
Backbone ribbons follow the polymer fold and remain continuous across observed guides without abrupt frame flips.
Broad helix/sheet faces remain legible; aspect control changes depth while retaining the physical width. Profile variants remain separate unfinished work.
The two Fab regions and Fc region retain the antiparallel beta-sandwich organisation visible in both references.

Terminal strand geometry has its authored shoulder at the last strand CA and tapers toward the next guide; N-to-C orientation follows source row order. Exact shoulder placement is covered by a straight-guide regression.

remaining: Full cartoon unit remains open: profiles, tubular helices, gaps, wedges, nucleotide choices and live ring coordinates.
reference_notes: MolFrame preserves deposited assignments per residue and fills unassigned residues; Mol* and PyMOL auto policies differ. 1IGT has 615 native strand assignments and 535 in each reference. SS-3 boundary-policy audit remains owned by Phase 3.7; this comparison does not certify identical secondary structure.
